behaviors: Actual showcase screens are mounted with the native engine boundary and driven through native events. NVM-1 proves repeated spatial waking and blocked sleeping content; NVM-2/3 responsive controls and live modal/settings state; NVM-4 async image cancellation, shimmer and deterministic chart; NVM-5 native drag-save and contextual similar actions; NVM-6 adaptive radial; NVM-7 scene failure containment; NVM-8 conversation menus and destructive touch actions; NVM-9 paging, native filtering, reorder and notes; NVM-10 tail-follow and reader retention; NVM-11 presentation remount scroll; NVM-12 selection trap/restore; NVM-13 interrupted tab animation and owner release.

Native modal source geometry transition and nested callout eligibility are also tested in native_navigation; native collection directional focus and selection are covered in native_collections. Product state is shared directly through Compose cells.

Live closure evidence is recorded in artifacts/compose-simplification/gap-closure-live.json: native emulated touch scrolling, held save and abandonment, spatial hit routing and repeated wake/overview, compact suggestions, largest-text phone/desktop layouts, short Chat, and native keyboard/gamepad activation and modal dismissal. Studio emulation is not a physical-device certification or exhaustive pixel comparison.
liveRequirements: Root-owned Studio verification: camera focus A to overview to B to overview to A, SurfaceGui hit routing and first pointer press consumed by WakeMonitor.

Root-owned Studio screenshots at desktop and narrow phone widths: all controls remain reachable, detail scroll clipping, HUD/radial fallback, creator loaded paint, sparkline, native scene rendering and card expansion.

Native keyboard/gamepad directional traversal through chrome/feed/settings/composer, hero controls, modal capture/restore and return to tabs; physical touch hit routing and native selection visibility are not simulated by the engine boundary double.
